transcript.text: Thank you all for joining. I want to address the concerns that have come up repeatedly about public corrections, after-hours requests, and unclear ownership of meeting decisions. As we know, our current guidance doesn't specify how these situations should be handled, and I have the authority to issue a department-wide communication charter to close those gaps. Before I draft anything, I want to follow our established practice and consult with line management, employees, team leadership, and Employee Relations. I'd like to hear from each of you on what you think the charter should address and any concerns you have.
